page.layout: One page of text. Running head at the top, centred. Page number at the top left. A large title in display type, then one column of running text. No marginal notes. Catchword at the lower right.

main_text.head: 28: Meditationes de Morte, postquam Domus utraq; de-nunciasset, nil amplius cum Rege Tractan-dum, & de Arctiori ejus Custodia in Arce Carisbrokiana.
main_text.p: Superest jam satis otii & nimis-causæ ut de Morte mediter, & Me illi parem: Pauci enim admodum passus restant inter Carceres Principum & Sepulchra.
Quòd hoc spatium cogitandi habeo, Dei indulgentia est: quod hanc tristem occasionem, hominum sævitia.
Præter enim commune illud omnibus Mor-
main_text.notes: Running head is Greek, printed ΕΙΚΩΝ ΒΑΣΙΛΙΚΗ; the printer's Λ appears as I, rendered here as Greek. The drop cap S is joined to "uperest". The hyphen marks at "nimis-" and "Pau-ci" are printed as line-end hyphens. Catchword "talitatis" is the start of the next page's first word. The title's first words are in swash type and read as Meditationes, Rege, Custodia, Arce.
